description: Ensures agent produces high-quality, non-generic UI designs

criteria.description: Skill prompt explicitly bans AI visual tells (pure black, neon glow, generic card layouts, Inter/Roboto fonts)
Skill prompt requires all 7 interaction states (default, hover, active, focus, loading, empty, error)
Skill prompt specifies spring/ease curves, not linear. Avoids janky animations.
Skill prompt enforces clear typography hierarchy with specific font choices
Skill prompt uses a deliberate color system, not arbitrary hex values
Skill prompt enforces consistent spacing scale (not random padding/margin values)
Skill prompt requires WCAG contrast ratios and focus-visible indicators
